audio.strategy: One AudioContext with Piano A/B layer buses, per-layer effect chains (Mod1→Mod2→Delay→Amp/EQ→Compressor→Reverb), shared Rotary via To Rotary, master gain and limiter. Grand/Upright/Electric/Clav/Digital/Misc use programmatically synthesized offline sample sets (not field recordings).

generatedSources.name: piano-sample-sets
generatedSources.description: Six type-specific sample sets synthesized via OfflineAudioContext at load time: distinct harmonic profiles, decay, and brightness per type. 5 root notes × 2 velocity layers each.

notes: Grand, Upright, and Electric are audibly distinct synthesized sample sets — honestly declared as generated, not recordings.
Organ, Synth, and Program controls remain presentation-only (Phase 1 honesty preserved).
Master Level knob scales master gain; Panic via blur/all-notes-off clears voices.
Polyphony limit 32 with deterministic oldest-voice stealing per layer pool.
